name: 49740 · Harbor Spgs, MI
findings: ZIP 49740 (Harbor Spgs) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49740 (Harbor Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
